Programming Languages: Proficient in the Python programming language.

Data Warehousing: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.

Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on optimizing data solutions.

Nice to Have

Certifications: Relevant certifications in Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Machine Learning Knowledge: Understanding of machine learning concepts and frameworks to support data science initiatives.

Agile Experience: Experience working in Agile environments and familiarity with DevOps + IaC practices.

Additional Programming Languages: Scala, Java, or R.

description:
Global HR | HR Strategy | Continuous Improvement | Employee Lifecycle | Project Management | Change & Transformation

Join Avanto - A Leader in the Furniture Industry!

About Avanto:

Avanto is an innovative and forward-thinking company transforming the furniture industry through technology and a people-centric approach. We stand out for our cutting-edge solutions, exceptional service, and strong commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation.

At Avanto, we foster an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and a results-driven culture. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the industry by driving change and continuous improvement.

About the Tech Lead / Architect

This role focuses on defining and evolving our sophisticated microservices architecture, establishing architectural patterns, and leading technical initiatives across frontend, backend, and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, evolve, and govern a scalable microservices architecture , including service boundaries and integration patterns.
  • Define and enforce architectural standards , coding guidelines, and best practices across engineering teams.
  • Evaluate, select, and standardize technologies, frameworks, and tooling aligned with long-term platform strategy.
  • Create reusable architectural patterns , reference implementations, and clearly defined golden paths .
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation , including ADRs, system diagrams, and technical specifications.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to ensure architectural alignment and consistency.
  • Participate in architectural and design reviews, providing guidance on complex technical decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical leader across the organization.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap , platform evolution strategy, and technology adoption decisions.
  • Design platform-wide performance optimization strategies , including caching, scalability patterns, and resource efficiency.
  • Define security architecture baselines , covering authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Architect end-to-end observability solutions , including metrics, logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of technical debt across the platform.
  • Proactively identify architectural risks and design mitigation strategies to ensure system reliability and resilience.
  • Design and enforce tenant isolation , data security, and boundary enforcement mechanisms.
  • Define tenant-aware routing, schema management, and data access patterns.
  • Architect tenant validation frameworks, authorization checks, and security controls.
  • Ensure scalable resource allocation and performance optimization in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Define service boundaries, domain models, and inter-service communication patterns.
  • Design and govern RESTful and GraphQL APIs , including versioning and integration strategies.
  • Architect event-driven systems , including message queues and asynchronous processing.
  • Define service mesh patterns such as service discovery, load balancing, and circuit breakers.
  • Design AWS cloud architecture, including multi-account strategies and cost optimization.
  • Define Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, including secure state management.
  • Architect containerization and orchestration strategies.
  • Design secure and scalable CI/CD pipelines , deployment strategies, and environment promotion models.

Observability Architecture

  • Design distributed tracing solutions using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.
  • Define metrics, dashboards, and alerting strategies using Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Establish structured logging, log aggregation, and analysis standards.
  • Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets across services.

Critical Architectural Challenges to Address

  • Security : JWT validation, tenant isolation, rate limiting, input validation, credential management.
  • Performance : Connection pooling, caching strategies, query optimization, frontend performance budgets.
  • Observability : End-to-end tracing, correlation IDs, metrics completeness, alerting maturity.
  • Multi-Tenancy : Prevent cross-tenant access and enforce strong validation mechanisms.

You will lead the architectural design and execution of solutions addressing these challenges.

Service-Specific Architecture Ownership

  • API Gateway : Routing, security, performance, and observability patterns.
  • Identity Service : OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, multi-tenant authentication and authorization.
  • GraphQL Services : Schema design, resolver optimization, query performance, and security controls.
  • RFQ & Workflow Services : Event-driven procurement workflows and integrations.
  • Data Upload Services : Streaming, memory optimization, scalability, and security controls.
  • AI Services : Secure and scalable AI integrations, async processing, tenant isolation, and performance optimization.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Architecture Expertise (Must Have)

  • Microservices Architecture : Design and evolution of distributed systems; service (text incomplete).
  • Multi-Tenancy Patterns : Schema-per-tenant architecture, tenant isolation, data security, tenant-aware routing, infrastructure as code strategies.
  • Large-Scale Systems : 100,000+ lines of code, complex business logic, enterprise patterns.
  • Distributed Systems : Service mesh, service discovery, distributed tracing, circuit breakers.
  • Performance Engineering : Query optimization, caching strategies, load balancing, scalability patterns.
  • Security Architecture : OAuth2/JWT, RBAC, data encryption, audit logging, security baselines.
  • Observability : Distributed tracing, metrics, logging, SLOs, error budgets.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Riscos identificados cedo e resolvidos antes de impactar a execução.

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Madrid office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Job description

Nosso time de Cobrança & Negociação:

O time de negociação abrange todo o processo de cobrança, envio de boleto, recálculo de parcelas e outros. É onde estreitamos nossa relação com clientes e entendemos qual o perfil de cada um para ajudar de maneira única e personalizada.

Nosso processo

Tudo começa por sua candidatura, e a partir disso construiremos uma jornada incrível. Saiba que para algumas vagas, temos uma avaliação técnica com nosso time de desenvolvedores e, por último, uma conversa com a pessoa que será sua liderança. O tempo do processo pode variar de acordo com a oportunidade, mas não se preocupe, pois garantimos nosso comprometimento em:

  • Analisar seu perfil com atenção e cuidado;
  • Oferecer feedback em todas as etapas;
  • Enviar e-mails com todas as informações necessárias.

Diversidade no DNA

Somente as diferenças podem nos levar além. Não abrimos mão disso. É inegociável.

Hoje, as mulheres ocupam mais da metade dos nossos espaços de decisão. Nosso compromisso é ampliar a inclusão de mulheres, pessoas negras, pessoas com deficiência (PCDs) e pessoas LGBTQIAPN+.

Agimos com base em três pilares:

Diversidade: Valorizamos a pluralidade e respeitamos todas as diferenças com empatia. Trabalhamos para que a Tripulação represente, de verdade, a sociedade onde vivemos;

⚖️Equidade: Acreditamos em caminhos justos para todas as pessoas. Garantir acesso, oportunidades e desenvolvimento é um dever, não uma exceção;

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão: experiência com sistemas de PDV e softwares de CRM.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados de vendas e interpretar relatórios para identificar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.

Benefícios

Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e aproveite todos esses benefícios!

Sobre Nossa Cultura

Na nossa empresa, acreditamos firmemente que Gente é o nosso principal ingrediente . A paixão pelo que fazemos impulsiona o nosso time, dedicado à qualidade inegociável das nossas entregas, proporcionando o melhor aos nossos consumidores. Somos um grupo recheado de orgulho , com o chocolate correndo em nossas veias, nos motivando a colocar paixão em cada aspecto do nosso trabalho e a manter viva a inquietude positiva que nos nutre e nos inspira a crescer. Nosso time é mão na massa, com uma atitude proativa para enfrentar desafios e alcançar novos patamares.

Orgulhamo‑nos da solidez e integridade que nos tornam reconhecidos no mercado, com mais de 1.000 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil para atender aos nossos consumidores.

Nossas Marcas: Valorizando a Qualidade e Inovação

Kopenhagen: Com uma tradição de mais de 95 anos, a Kopenhagen é reconhecida como uma grife de chocolates finos. Pioneira no segmento no Brasil, destacamo‑nos pela qualidade inigualável de produtos predominantemente artesanais, embalagens sofisticadas, além de oferecer um café inconfundível e opções de presentes desejadas. Aqui, a qualidade é a nossa essência, e cada produto é uma expressão do nosso comprometimento com a excelência.

Chocolates Brasil Cacau: Com um espírito jovem, alegre e autêntico, a Chocolates Brasil Cacau é diferente de todas as outras. Estamos aqui para atender aos brasileiros com muita originalidade, valorizando a diversidade. Nossa marca é uma expressão do nosso jeito plural, assumidamente brasileira, agregando diferenças e semelhanças. A cultura brasileira é vivenciada, reconhecida e manifestada em forma de arte, resultando em deliciosos chocolates que refletem a riqueza de nossa identidade.

Kop Koffee: Criada em 2019, a Kop Koffee é o lugar perfeito para compartilhar momentos de prazer, unindo o sabor do café à inconfundível qualidade dos chocolates Kopenhagen. Aqui, o sabor de inovação não é apenas um ingrediente, mas a energia que nos impulsiona a seguir inovando continuamente e proporcionando uma experiência única para os apaixonados por café e chocolate.

Descubra o incrível universo do chocolate, onde cada conexão transforma momentos comuns em experiências extraordinárias.

Sinta‑se convidado a fazer parte desse cenário envolvente e deixe sua marca, contribuindo para tornar cada momento inesquecível nesse universo apaixonante do chocolate.

description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible to propose, analyse and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions

  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators

  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

About You

Must-haves

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I-CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces – GM Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc.
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Recognition rewards

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Acting as a Trusted Advisor, you will ensure best practices in the use of our platform and support the success journey of our clients. You will validate, test, and debug complex issues related to clients’ use of Azion systems, and research new technologies to deliver tailored solutions. As a Solutions Architect, you must be committed to scalability, performance, high availability, and security best practices, ensuring success across various industries such as Finance, E-commerce, Media, and Education.

You are highly technical, client-focused, and able to communicate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally. You understand enterprise environments, argue from a technical perspective, and inspire confidence. You stay up to date with Azion’s platform and market innovations and most importantly, you take initiative and chase results.

Your Impact

  • Actively participate in the planning and structuring of integration projects;
  • Integrate client systems with Azion’s platform, guiding and configuring environments when necessary;
  • Be the go-to expert for Azion products and solutions;
  • Support Customer Growth teams in guiding clients through their success journey, including resolving questions and engaging with Product and Engineering teams;
  • Support Technical Support teams by acting as a platform expert;
  • Identify and propose improvements in both processes and products driven by customer demand or internal insights;
  • Research and propose effective solutions for complex and non-standard use cases (corner cases).

What You’ll Bring

  • Understanding (and eagerness to learn) about networks and how the Internet works;
  • Protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, BGP;
  • Security solutions: Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, Paywall;
  • Configuration and use of proxies and reverse proxies;
  • Content Delivery Networks (CDN), including caching and edge caching;
  • Experience with troubleshooting techniques: connectivity, routing, protocol errors, web applications, application mapping, etc.;
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization: latency, throughput, load distribution, load balancing;
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, BASH, JavaScript);
  • Proactive mindset for identifying and suggesting improvements;
  • Ability to handle multiple projects in an organized and collaborative way;
  • Ability to manage priorities, deadlines, and project delivery;
  • Willingness to stay updated with market technology trends;
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology Management, or equivalent experience;

Bonus Points

  • Experience in consulting, technical training, or customer support;
  • Ability to analyze and define modern, distributed architectures;
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event/function-based integration;
  • Hands‑on experience with serverless and Function as a Service (FaaS) models, including Lambda Functions, Cloudlets, Workers, or similar technologies, with a focus on low latency, scalability, and orchestration;
  • Knowledge of streaming, distributed storage, high‑performance web servers, security, and cloud environments;
  • Advanced English and Spanish.

Vaga de Especialista de Produtos Jr - BMW Genius

Descrição

Estamos em busca de um Especialista de Produtos Jr para se juntar ao nosso time.

O que é um BMW Genius?

Um BMW Genius é um especialista em produtos da BMW, treinado para oferecer uma experiência de atendimento ao cliente focada em educação e informação, em vez de vendas. A função principal deles é guiar os clientes através dos recursos, tecnologias e funcionalidades dos veículos BMW, garantindo que o cliente tome uma decisão informada e se sinta confiante com o produto.

Principais responsabilidades de um BMW Genius:

  • Demonstração do produto : Eles são os responsáveis por apresentar detalhadamente os modelos, explicando as inovações, motores, sistemas de assistência ao motorista, e outros recursos. Eles podem, por exemplo, demonstrar como funciona o sistema de estacionamento automático ou o iDrive.

  • Aconselhamento e orientação : O Genius não tem metas de venda e, portanto, pode oferecer conselhos imparciais sobre qual modelo ou tecnologia se adapta melhor ao estilo de vida do cliente. Eles ajudam a comparar diferentes opções sem a pressão de fechar uma compra.

  • Suporte pós-venda : Após a compra, o Genius está disponível para auxiliar o cliente a se familiarizar com o novo carro. Eles podem ajudar a configurar o smartphone no veículo, explicar as funcionalidades do painel ou resolver dúvidas sobre o uso diário.

  • Treinamento : Eles recebem treinamento constante da BMW para se manterem atualizados sobre todos os novos modelos e tecnologias. Isso permite que eles sejam uma fonte confiável de informação, seja sobre um carro recém-lançado ou uma nova atualização de software.

Em resumo, o BMW Genius é um consultor, um educador e um embaixador da marca, focado em criar um relacionamento de confiança com o cliente, oferecendo um serviço de alto nível e conhecimento técnico aprofundado. Eles complementam o trabalho do vendedor, garantindo que a jornada de compra seja a mais informativa e agradável possível.

Overview:

We are seeking a Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear Specialist to join the Technical Services Division/ High Voltage Equipment Unit (HVEU). The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support the safe and reliable operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks. Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support in regards to designs, standards, commissioning, maintenance, operation, investigation in order to ensure safe and reliable Power Supply.

Key Responsibilities:

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Serves as Subject Matter Expert in equipment failures and repair techniques during root cause investigations.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis on all critical equipment failures.
  • Perform continuous review of the HV equipment maintenance programs to identify improvements to ensure the HV asset's safe and reliable operation.
  • Provide technical consultation to the maintenance agency as required in identifying and reviewing critical spare parts lists of existing equipment.
  • Provide technical consultation to assess the condition of aging switchgears and breakers including the use of new innovative technologies.
  • Provide technical expertise on troubleshooting failures, repairs, and evaluating if the equipment is designed to meet its intended or existing service conditions.
  • Provide technical engineering input on repair details and offers onsite technical support, especially for critical equipment for the process.
  • Provide engineering input for switchgear work packages to ensure Saudi Aramco standards and material specifications are followed.
  • Review and update company standards and be familiar with international standards.

As a successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years’ experience of operations and maintenance experience directly working with MV switchgear/control gear.
  • You will have In-depth knowledge, experience, and recognition as a switchgear specialist including membership of international engineering bodies and contribution at international conferences.
  • Background in the oil and gas industry or equipment manufacturers is a plus.
  • Professional Engineer certification such as chartership or PE is a plus.
  • You will have a working Knowledge of ANSI and IEC designed switchgear, breaker design (including mechanisms and interruption technology - vacuum, air, compressed air, SF-6), motor control gears, motor contactors, and pad-mounted SF-6 equipment.
  • You will have the ability to multi-task and manage changing priorities and seek opportunities to improve results and processes proactively, contributing to the goals, safety, and profitability of the company.
  • You will be able to integrate and quickly applying newly acquired technical information
  • You will have strong speaking, writing, and customer service skills.
  • You will also be able to complete daily work activities with limited supervision and able to work cooperatively in a team environment.

Work Location and Work Schedule:

Work location: Within Saudi Arabia: On-Site

Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer

description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We\'ve built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you\'ll do

We\'re looking for an AWS Cost Optimization Specialist . At Clara, our infrastructure is the backbone of our financial services, and managing it efficiently is key to our scalability and unit economics. You will design and execute Clara\'s AWS cost optimization strategy, moving beyond simple monitoring to proactive financial engineering.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between Engineering and Finance, ensuring that every dollar spent on the cloud translates into direct value for our customers. You will drive visibility into cost per transaction and cost per product while building the automated governance required for a high-growth fintech.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Analysis: Design and execute the global AWS cost optimization strategy, continuously identifying savings across EC2 , ECS , and Aurora clusters.
  • Governance & Tagging: Implement standardized tagging strategies for precise cost allocation by domain, squad, country, and product.
  • Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize AWS Kafka clusters, OpenSearch storage strategies, and networking/data transfer costs to ensure lean operations.
  • FinOps Automation: Define and implement automated shutdown policies for non-production environments and configure advanced anomaly detection and budget alerts.
  • Data & Dashboards: Build executive and operational dashboards using AWS Cost Explorer, Athena , or QuickSight to provide real-time visibility into cloud spend.
  • Architectural Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to design cost-efficient architectures and establish long-term cloud financial governance standards.

Who you are

“We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.”

Must haves:

  • 4+ years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments, with a proven track record in cloud cost optimization initiatives.
  • Strong technical knowledge of EC2 , EBS, RDS, S3, EKS , Lambda, and CloudFront.
  • Mastery of AWS Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and multi-account environment management via AWS Organizations.
  • Experience implementing FinOps best practices and strong understanding of cost modeling.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, specifically Terraform .
  • Ability to analyze cost data using SQL , Athena , or Python .
  • Working proficiency in English and Spanish.
  • Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and detect spending patterns.

Nice to haves:

  • AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps, or Advanced Networking).
  • Experience in regulated environments (PCI, SOC2).
  • Experience with cloud cost management and optimization platforms (CloudHealth, CloudCheckr, or native AWS cost tools).
  • Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.
  • A good sense of humor.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world\'s fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

#Pride. We build products and experiences we\'re proud of.

#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you\u2019re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara employees in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don\'t enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you\'re expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Overview

Join to apply for the Engineering Lead role at TELUS Digital Brazil .

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times per week or 8 days per month) or Porto Alegre (3 times per week or 12 days per month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As an Engineering Lead at TELUS Digital, you’ll be a manager of a highly skilled engineering team building amazing digital products for our clients, and you’ll help them achieve their personal and professional goals. You’ll also drive the team and our clients to use cutting-edge techniques and processes for software delivery, and use your technical prowess to shape the solutions we create. Success looks like an energized, happy team building high-quality software for eager, engaged client stakeholders.

We understand our responsibility to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive place within the tech industry, while pushing to make our industry more representative. Because of this responsibility, we need candidates who value diversity and inclusion through their work, team collaboration, or mentorship.

Qualifications

  • Have professional engineering experience — at least 5 years building digital products, and at least 2 years leading a team;

  • Fluent English and Portuguese skills – including written, verbal, and presentation;

  • Account planning and growth activities

  • Are comfortable collaborating and communicating with teams and clients to deliver software in an agile environment
  • Think of the product you are building as part of an ecosystem of development, testing and deployment tools and processes
  • Pride yourself on your work and take responsibilities and commitments seriously
  • Value daily opportunities to immerse yourself deeply in your work
  • Celebrate differences and thrive in an environment where everyone’s unique contributions are encouraged
  • Value a feedback culture that fosters personal and professional growth

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some Of Our Benefits

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equality

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that Information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

  • Deep knowledge of load balancing, SSL/TLS offloading, session persistence, and traffic management.
  • Experience in high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

Qualifications

title: Analytics Analyst - Agriculture
description:
Fastmarkets is an industry‑leading price‑reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, offering price data, news, analytics and events for agriculture, forest products, metals and mining, and new‑generation energy markets. Fastmarkets’ data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. With a history dating back to 1865, Fastmarkets is a global business with more than 700 employees across the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond.

The Role

The Grains Analyst is responsible for delivering market intelligence, price forecasting, and analytical insights across global corn, barley, and wheat markets. This role strengthens Fastmarkets’ grains coverage by producing timely commentary, enhancing analytical methodologies, and supporting the commercialization of our agriculture analytics products.

The analyst will play a key role in evolving our grains analytics offering, currently focused on monthly forecasting and short‑term commentary, and expanding our capabilities in line with client demand for transparent, actionable insights across feed, food, and biofuel‑linked grain markets.

The ideal candidate is interested in economic and commodity market research and will thrive in a fast‑paced and innovative environment, have a can‑do attitude, juggle various tasks and projects, and meet deadlines.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Data gathering, analysis, and forecasting
  • Producing written commentary, fundamental outlooks, data visualizations, and price forecasts
  • Building industry knowledge and contacts
  • Client contact and presentations

Qualifications

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully. If you are open‑minded, curious, resilient, solutions‑oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

Knowledge, Experience and Skills

  • Understanding of global food and feed grain production regions and their trade interdependencies
  • Familiarity with how global energy policy impacts agricultural product supply and demand
  • Experience building or maintaining commodity supply/demand models, price models, and short‑term forecasting processes
  • Experience supporting commercial teams or engaging clients with insights and market outlook commentary
  • Able to critically assess statistical analyses and forecast models and suggest improvements and develop new models
  • Excellent written and verbal English

Behavioral Competencies

  • Manage deadlines across multiple forecasting cycles with strong time‑management and task‑prioritization skills
  • Willingness to learn new technological tools, new processes, or updated analytics workflows
  • Maintain attention to detail in data, commentary, and forecasting outputs
  • Communicate complex market drivers and forecasts clearly to both technical and commercial audiences
  • Ensure commentary and forecasts are actionable and relevant to traders, processors, food companies, and biofuel participants
  • Build strong relationships with colleagues in analytics, editorial, sales, data engineering/science, and consulting

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Additional Information

Our Values

  • METRICS DRIVEN . We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE . We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE . We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC . We are customer‑centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE . We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Desenvolvedor Jr - Joinville
description:
Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, tem habilidade para conectar pessoas a soluções inovadoras e deseja atuar no mercado contábil, essa vaga é para você!

Na Ottimizza, temos um propósito claro: alavancar a produtividade e a qualidade de vida nas contabilidades do Brasil através dos nosso produtos. E queremos que você faça parte dessa jornada, ajudando-nos a cumprir nossa visão de sermos reconhecidos pelo mercado contábil como um verdadeiro agente de mudança através da tecnologia.

SOBRE A VAGA:

Buscamos um profissional com interesse em desenvolver, manter e evoluir integrações (RPAs) entre nossos sistemas e os sistemas dos clientes, atuando na criação de novas rotinas, melhorias contínuas, correções e apoio na resolução de incidentes, sempre em colaboração com o time e com foco em qualidade e estabilidade das soluções.

REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Conhecimento em Java
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL e capacidade de criar e otimizar consultas SQL
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST (consumo e/ou desenvolvimento)
  • Experiência profissional de 1+ anos como desenvolvedor(a)
  • Vivência com controle de versão usando Git/GitHub
  • Experiência com gestão de tarefas/rotina de time usando Jira
  • Inglês intermediário, com foco em leitura e compreensão de documentação técnica

PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL ESPERADO:

Buscamos um profissional com facilidade para atuar de forma colaborativa dentro de uma célula de negócio, mantendo comunicação clara e objetiva com os pares nas demandas internas do dia a dia. É importante ter organização e senso de responsabilidade para equilibrar atividades de manutenção e novas entregas, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos. Espera-se um perfil analítico, com foco na identificação e resolução de problemas, além de proatividade para aprender, evoluir tecnicamente e contribuir com a melhoria contínua das soluções.

DIFERENCIAIS DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Conhecimento em Spring (Spring Boot)
  • Conhecimento em Angular
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento (ex.: GitHub Copilot, Cursor ou similares)
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns, boas práticas de código e metodologias de desenvolvimento
  • Boa base de lógica de programação e interesse em escrever código limpo e sustentável

POR QUE TRABALHAR NA OTTIMIZZA?

  • Espaço real para estruturar e melhorar processos
  • Atuação próxima à liderança e ao negócio
  • Oportunidade de crescimento junto com a empresa
  • Treinamentos e capacitação contínua para seu desenvolvimento profissional
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador

LOCAL DE TRABALHO

Híbrido: Joinville/SC ou Blumenau/SC

title: [BANCO DE TALENTOS - Consultor Pedagógico] - Venha trabalhar no LIV!
description:
(BANCO DE TALENTOS - Consultor Pedagógico) - Venha trabalhar no LIV!

Estamos em busca de um profissional apaixonado por educação, com entusiasmo, muito brilho nos olhos e experiência pedagógica para atender escolas do Brasil. Atuará com apresentação, treinamento, formação continuada e consultoria pedagógica do LIV para educação básico.

  • Representar o programa junto às escolas parceiras;
  • Realizar acompanhamento pedagógico;
  • Realizar atendimentos, reuniões e aulas junto às escolas parceiras;
  • Oferecer soluções pedagógicas para professoras e professores.
  • Graduação completa em Psicologia.
  • Grande disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Habilidades relacionais: empatia, escuta, foco no cliente;
  • Experiência no campo educacional;
  • Conhecer a realidade da escola, falar a linguagem dos educadores;
  • Gostar do universo escolar, ter abertura para os desafios da educação nacional.
  • Experiência prévia com educação socioemocional;
  • Conhecer programas de educação socioemocional.

Não podemos escolher o que sentimos, mas podemos aprender o que fazer com nossos sentimentos. Já pensou nisso?

Prazer, somos o Laboratório Inteligência de Vida, mas pode chamar de LIV!Entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos.

Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Vem com a gente nessa jornada?

Pessoas colaborativas - Acreditamos que juntos somos capazes de encontrar as melhores soluções;

Crescimento com responsabilidade e propósito - Reconhecemos que a ética e o impacto pedagógico são inegociáveis no nosso dia a dia;

Cuidado e escuta com quem faz o LIV - Valorizamos o cuidado e o respeito como partes imprescindíveis do nosso trabalho, por isso somos empáticos e acolhedores;

Visão em movimento -Somos inquietos, propositivos e inovamos para entregar a melhor experiência socioemocional;

Compromisso com a nossa comunidade - Tomamos decisões a partir do que as nossas escolas têm a dizer, praticando a escuta ativa e a cultura de feedbacks.

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa suíça, e de fazer parte de um time com mais de 90 mil colaboradores no mundo?

Junte-se a uma equipe reconhecida por sua excelência, inovação, integridade, colaboração, segurança e espírito empreendedor.

No Brasil, são 6 linhas de negócios. Business Assurance, Health & Nutrition, Connectivity & Products, Natural Resources, Industries & Environment and Education.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pelo planejamento, coordenação e implementação de sistemas, políticas e programas de gestão de saúde e segurança ocupacional, garantindo a eliminação ou redução de riscos nos ambientes de trabalho e assegurando a conformidade legal da empresa. Atuando de forma estratégica nos planos de segurança específicos para obras de pavimentação, sinalização, intervenções emergenciais em rodovias, e outras atividades relacionadas, visando a prevenção de acidentes a minimização de riscos e a prevenção de impactos ambientais. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a análise e mitigação de riscos em atividades críticas, como operações em rodovias com tráfego ativo, e a definição de estratégias para garantir a integridade física dos colaboradores, usuários e terceiros;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizadas planilhas com estatísticas de acidentes de trabalho, encaminhando relatórios periódicos para órgãos fiscalizadores e áreas de controle de sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar demandas de órgãos reguladores e públicos externos, garantindo o envio de informações no formato exigido;
  • Fiscalizar irregularidades de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Compliance (QSSMA) em vistorias de campo. Assegurar a aderência aos requisitos legais, regulamentares e normas internas da empresa;
  • Elaborar relatórios e registros fotográficos detalhados, encaminhando-os ao gestor imediato e ao gestor responsável pela área. Garantir a execução das atividades em alinhamento com as Regras de Ouro do Grupo CCR e normas de QSSMA, promovendo comportamentos seguros e prevenindo;
  • Atualizar e monitorar informações em sistemas operacionais específicos, incluindo CAT, PPRA, controle de extintores, EPI/EPC, brigadas de incêndio, CIPA, e relatórios periódicos;
  • Supervisionar a manutenção e disponibilidade de dispositivos de combate a incêndio, como extintores, hidrantes e alarmes, em conformidade com normas regulamentares. Supervisionar empresas terceirizadas em obras, verificando o cumprimento das normas de segurança, uso de EPIs/EPCs, e dispositivos de segurança coletiva;
  • Elaborar, revisar e implementar anualmente o PPRA - Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, incluindo medições de riscos e propostas de soluções para mitigação;
  • Realizar investigações de acidentes, identificar causas-raiz e propor ações corretivas e preventivas. Acompanhar perícias judiciais relacionadas a acidentes de trabalho, em alinhamento com a área jurídica. Promover o Índice de Prática Segura (IPS) e ações de melhoria contínua com base em desvios identificados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de treinamento e conscientização de segurança para equipes internas e contratadas. Contribuir para a gestão sustentável de resíduos no local de trabalho, conforme os aspectos e impactos ambientais da unidade. Monitorar e avaliar o impacto ambiental de obras em conformidade com os padrões internos e normativos.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia com Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • 6 meses de experiência no cargo;
  • Experiência comprovada em obras rodoviárias ou contratos de concessão;
  • Pacote Office avançado.

Condições de contratação

  • Modelo de contratação PJ;
  • Residir na região de Porangaba, Boituva, Tatuí e Sorocaba;

Procuramos pessoas como você. Pessoas que vão abraçar a jornada na SGS com a mesma intensidade e paixão que nós fazemos! E aí? Topa desenvolver conexões mais fortes, seguras e mais eficientes na conosco?

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.
Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Employee Assistance Programme

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Credit Risk Lead
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Credit Risk Lead role at R2 .

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank. R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight knit team coming from organizations such as Amazon, Google, Nubank, Capital One, Uber, Mercado Libre, Globant, J.P. Morgan and HSBC. We are backed by world-class investors such as Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI-focused fund), COMETA, General Catalyst, Hi Ventures, Y Combinator, Femsa Ventures, Prosus, Endeavor Catalyst, among others.

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Credit Risk Lead to drive decision-making processes and optimize credit portfolio performance. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling to enhance risk assessment, develop actionable insights, and improve operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate cross-functionally and influence strategic decisions at the core of our credit risk infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis
    • Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations that influence credit risk and financial performance.
    • Provide actionable insights to key stakeholders to improve risk management strategies.
    • Provide actionable insights that can be reflected in Credit Policy
  • Machine Learning & AI
    • Develop and enhance predictive models using machine learning techniques to assess and mitigate credit risk.
    • Optimize algorithms to improve model performance and reduce risk exposure.
  • Portfolio Risk Assessment
    • Collaborate with the risk management team to evaluate the risk profile of the credit portfolio.
    • Forecast future risk trends and recommend data-driven mitigation strategies.
  • A/B Testing
    • Design and conduct A/B tests to evaluate the impact of new features on risk performance and adoption metrics.
  • Reporting & Visualization
